test_partition_note: This module never loads the test partition. Final evaluation is a separate entry point that runs after this artifact is frozen.
condition_description: Condition A restricted to annotator lesion boxes: the tightest oracle ROI and the only one that isolates the lesion.

quantum.shots_note: Exact statevector evaluation. No shot sampling, so there is no shot noise to report.
quantum.ansatz: per layer: ry(theta) and rz(psi) on every qubit, then a linear nearest-neighbour CNOT cascade with circular closure

seeds.note: seed_everything() seeds numpy and qiskit_algorithms.algorithm_globals inside OptimizerSpec.minimize; weight initialisation uses its own Generator(seed) so it cannot depend on optimiser call order.

class_imbalance_handling.method: inverse-frequency class weights normalised to mean 1
class_imbalance_handling.applied_in: the training loss only; no resampling, no synthetic samples

validation_selection.selection_metric_rationale: The positive class is small, so PR-AUC discriminates between candidates where accuracy and ROC-AUC do not.

compute_budget.note: Full depth sweep affordable here: 215 train rows at ~29ms/sample is ~6.3s per objective evaluation. The full-partition conditions (1692 rows, ~49s per evaluation) select their depth from this sweep instead of repeating it.

early_stopping.reason: SPSA's trajectory is stochastic; stopping on a noisy validation reading selects for the noise. Every candidate ran its full iteration budget and selection happened across candidates.

threshold.note: Chosen on the uncalibrated score (1 - <Z0>)/2. Calibration is a separate stage and is also fitted without the test partition.

hardware_feasibility.note: Reported separately from every simulator result. No simulator number in this artifact should be read as a hardware feasibility claim.

simulator_shortcut.statement: Training loads the 65,536 amplitudes with Aer's set_statevector, which writes them into simulator memory. It is not state preparation on hardware and implies nothing about hardware feasibility.

ansatz.coupling_map: none (all-to-all assumed; a real device adds SWAP overhead)

state_preparation_at_16_qubits.reason: Transpiling an arbitrary 65,536-amplitude StatePreparation is itself 2**16-scale work; the smaller widths above are measured instead and the extrapolation is shown rather than asserted.
state_preparation_at_16_qubits.interpretation: Preparing one arbitrary 16-qubit state costs on the order of 62,940 CX gates, against an upper bound of 131,038. The ansatz itself needs 16 CX. State preparation therefore dominates the circuit by roughly 3,934x, and against current hardware coherence times this circuit is not runnable. That is a property of amplitude-encoding 65,536 values, not of the ansatz.
